Teamed up with VCUarts graduate cohort to create custom, limited-edition bookmarks for the David Zwirner Books' holiday season. Each of us designed and printed a bookmark to be included in a set of six.

In collaboration with Luiza Dale, Molly Garrett, Aya Khalife, Irene Piazza and Nneoma Njoku.
